name: Bionic Reading & Fonts
author: patatasbravasch-arch
description: Bionic reading, typography, toolbar controls, FF think fix, LumiRealm compatibility, configurable auto-regeneration, persistent settings, and Lorebook Cleanup. v0.48 uses Lumiverse's authenticated same-origin REST API for lorebook cleanup, identifies books not linked to any character card, and finds exact duplicates that can be relinked to one shared copy.
